files.name: motion-prompt-071.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Badge" (バッジ), one of the names in "UI component names".
Motion Prompt #071

What it is: A small dot with a number showing a count
What the sample shows: Each time a notification arrives, the blue dot on the bell in the header counts up 1, 2, 3; clicking the bell clears it.
Spec:
- 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 54-tall header with a line-drawn bell at (482, 27) on the right.
- Badge: a blue circle of radius 12 at the bell's top right (+12, −12), 2.5 px white rim, white 14 px number.
- Notifications arrive at 0.7, 1.3 and 1.9 s: the count goes 1 → 2 → 3. The first scales in over 0.7–0.9 s with easeOutCubic.
- Each arrival pops the scale from 1.3 back to 1 over 0.3 s and sends out a ripple ring (radius 12 → 28, opacity 0.5 → 0) over 0.5 s.
- The cursor reaches the bell at 2.95 s and clicks at 3.0 s; the badge shrinks to 0 over 3.0–3.25 s with easeInOutCubic.
When to use it: Use it to call attention to a count, such as unread messages or items in a cart.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/071.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/ui.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
